name: KernelBench
intro: KernelBench 是一个评估语言模型能否为真实 PyTorch 机器学习工作负载生成正确且高效 GPU 内核的开放基准。论文版包含 250 题，覆盖单算子、可融合算子序列和完整模型架构，并用目标 GPU 上的正确性与加速比联合评分。
build_method: 真实PyTorch工作负载整理, 三级任务分区, 固定输入生成器
build_method_en: Real PyTorch Workload Curation, Three-Level Task Partitioning, Fixed Input Generators
intro_en: KernelBench is an open benchmark for evaluating whether language models can generate correct and efficient GPU kernels for real PyTorch machine-learning workloads. The paper benchmark has 250 tasks across primitive operators, fusible operator sequences, and full model architectures, jointly scored by correctness and target-GPU speedup.
metric_en: fast(p) (fast(0) correctness; fast(1) faster than PyTorch)
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2502.10517 and the official ScalingIntelligence repository. The paper benchmark has exactly 250 evaluation-only tasks in three levels: 100 single primitive operations, 100 multi-operator sequences with fusion opportunities, and 50 full ML architectures sourced from popular PyTorch repositories. The current repository later adds a Level 4 extension, but the diagram preserves the paper's three-level contract. Every task packages a torch.nn.Module Model plus get_inputs and get_init_inputs to fix tensor shapes and precision; no gold kernel is supplied. The paper's one-shot prompt includes one addition Model/ModelNew example, and greedy decoding returns optimized ModelNew code using any suitable kernel language or library. On the target L40S, compilation and execution precede five randomized output-equivalence checks. Timing uses three warm-ups and 100 CUDA-event trials, with mean speedup equal to PyTorch Eager time divided by generated-kernel time. fast(p) is the fraction both correct and faster than threshold p; fast(0) is correctness and fast(1) means faster than PyTorch.
